findings.detail: The extractor creates negative-cost revolver or delayed-draw holdings that are not separate positions in the March 31, 2026 source schedule.

rationale: C107 is a repeated Class 1 negative-cost pattern. Raw-source checks for Accel International, Kaman, and TITAN BW BORROWER show positive-cost term-loan rows only. The extracted flagged rows instead add negative-cost revolver or delayed-draw positions (for example, Accel cost -140,000 versus the source term-loan cost 186,181,000). The same mismatch across sampled issuers grounds a systematic extraction artifact rather than legitimate negative investment cost. Residual risk is limited to uninspected flagged rows, but the repeated mechanism is strongly evidenced.
